name: Google Gemini
tagline: Google's AI assistant for chat, writing, research and Google apps, with a free plan and paid AI Plus, Pro and Ultra plans; Workspace and Education editions have separate data terms

evidence.quote: Gemini Apps are provided by Google Ireland Limited in the European Economic Area and Switzerland and by Google LLC everywhere else.

vendor_entity.note: In the EEA and Switzerland the consumer Gemini app is provided by Google Ireland Limited.

evidence.quote: organized under the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, and operating under the laws of the USA
The ultimate parent company for all Google Group Subprocessors listed below is Google LLC, which is itself a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.

parent_country.note: Alphabet Inc. is named as parent, but its headquarters country is not stated on the pages read.

eu_representative.note: Looked in the Google privacy policy, Gemini Apps Privacy Notice and Gemini Apps Privacy Hub. No Article 27 representative named. Google Ireland Limited serves the EEA.

evidence.quote: To exercise these rights, you can create a request in our Help Center

dpo_contact.note: Privacy requests go through the Help Center form. No named DPO found.

hosting_regions.note: Default storage regions for Gemini app data are not stated on the pages read. Workspace customers can select a data region (see eu_residency). Looked in the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub, the Workspace Gemini privacy hub, the Cloud DPA and the Workspace service terms.

evidence.quote: We rely on other Google services and infrastructure to provide Gemini Apps.

local_first.note: Gemini Apps are a hosted service; the pages read describe no local-only mode.

evidence.quote: Customer may select a Data Region as described at the Workspace Data Regions Page for storage of Covered Data at rest

eu_residency.note: Applies to Workspace Covered Data. The Workspace Gemini privacy hub says data region settings do not apply to Gemini Notebook. Consumer Gemini: not stated.

evidence.quote: all processing occurs within Google's secure infrastructure

cloud_providers.note: Own infrastructure as described by the vendor. No third-party cloud provider named for Gemini Apps.

subprocessors_public.note: Cloud list covers the Gemini platform and AI services. A separate Workspace list also exists at workspace.google.com/terms/subprocessors (not counted).

subprocessors_count.note: Counted rows in the Google Cloud subprocessor page as cached: 39 third-party entities plus 75 Google group entities. Gemini Apps consumer list not counted separately.

subprocessors_non_eea.note: Counted entities among the 114 whose listed country of processing includes a country outside the EEA (e.g. United States, India, Japan). Count made from the cached table.

dpa.note: Cloud Data Processing Addendum is published and applies to Workspace-with-Gemini customer data. Workspace DPA was not fetched (its URL returned 404 on the cached attempt).

evidence.quote: Google is a processor and Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable

role.note: Institutional answer under the Cloud DPA. For personal Google accounts, the Gemini Apps Privacy Notice describes Google using chats to improve its services, so the consumer role differs.

from the default of 18 months to 3 months, 36 months, or indefinite

retention_stated.note: Consumer default auto-delete is 18 months. Reviewed chats are kept up to three years.

evidence.quote: Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

deletion_on_exit.note: Cloud DPA section 6.2: after term end, up to 180 days after a recovery period of up to 30 days.

data_export.note: The Gemini Apps Privacy Hub says users can export their information but does not state the formats for Gemini chats. Looked in the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub and Workspace hub.

evidence.quote: Temporary chats and chats you have when Keep Activity is off are retained with your account for 72 hours

ai_zero_retention.note: The vendor is also the model provider. Retention for temporary chats is stated as 72 hours, so zero retention is not stated.
